name: singlet_embedding_viz_global_structure_preservation
title: Global structure preservation of a 2D map
description: Scores how well a two-dimensional embedding keeps the arrangement of annotated groups, the distances between waypoint cells and group centroids, and random triplet orderings, against a high-dimensional reference (default normalised layer). Writes per-embedding scores to uns and, when paired maps are given, initialisation effects. Use it to compare maps and initialisations. Do not use it for local neighbourhoods (use the local-neighbourhood tool) or to read cluster sizes or spacing as biology.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

embedding.description: Key in obsm of the two-dimensional map to score.

paired_embeddings.description: Other obsm maps of the same cells that differ only in initialisation; adds paired differences.

label_key.description: Obs column of author annotations defining groups; fixed before the map was computed.

reference.description: High-dimensional reference geometry against which distances and orderings are compared.

space.description: normalized: log-normalised genes; pca50: leading PCs; spectral: UMAP spectral layout of waypoints, seeded.

n_components.description: Leading principal components used when space is pca50.

scores.description: Score families to compute; label and centroid scores need label_key; triplet_random needs no labels.

distance_correlation.description: Options for waypoint, centroid and label distance correlations.

correlation.description: Spearman as in OpenProblems; Pearson as in cellstruct. Reported separately.

upper_triangle_only.description: Use unique pairs only; false reproduces the OpenProblems flattened full matrix.

max_waypoints.description: Waypoint cap; larger datasets are subsampled with the seed.

triplets.description: Options for random-anchor and centroid triplet accuracy.

margin.description: Relative margin of the tolerant variant; 0 gives the strict variant only.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for waypoint sampling and triplet anchors.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory, device and waypoint count without computing scores.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/global_structure/X_umap. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Per embedding: scores with intervals, label and waypoint counts, correlation type, paired initialisation differences, timing_s and peak_memory_gb. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, n_waypoints.
